blocks.text: Hillside Custom Estates vs. Valley-Floor ALR Acreages

parts.t: should weigh topography, servicing, and zoning. Upland properties sit inside Development Permit Area 2 (Hillside and Upland) and typically rely on drilled wells and private septic systems, while valley-bottom acreages sit primarily inside the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR) with high-capability flat soils, irrigation access, and Fraser or Vedder River floodplain elevation standards.

blocks.text: ALR House-Size Rules, PTT Above $2M & Technical Due Diligence

parts.t: When purchasing an acreage, custom residence, or development parcel over $1.8 million, due diligence includes reviewing Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) principal and additional residence floor-area limits on ALR land, potable well-water flow and water-quality testing, Type 1/2/3 septic inspection filings, geotechnical covenants on hillside lots, and BC Property Transfer Tax (which adds a 3% tier above $2,000,000 and an additional 2% tier on residential value above $3,000,000). blocks.text: Chilliwack Homes Over $1.8M Real Estate FAQs

parts.t: Where are most Chilliwack homes over $1.8 million located?

Properties above $1.8 million are concentrated in Ryder Lake, Majuba Hill, Greendale, Yarrow, East Chilliwack, Rosedale, Chilliwack Mountain, Little Mountain, Eastern Hillsides (around The Falls), Promontory ridge lines, and waterfront or beach pockets at Cultus Lake.
What is the BC Property Transfer Tax rate on Chilliwack homes over $2M and $3M?

BC Property Transfer Tax is 1% on the first $200,000, 2% from $200,000 to $2,000,000, 3% on the portion above $2,000,000, plus a further 2% (5% total) on the residential portion above $3,000,000. On agricultural ALR properties, the extra 2% above $3M applies only to the residential value (the house and 0.5 hectare residential footprint), not the classified farm land.
What are the house-size rules on ALR acreage in Chilliwack?

Under BC Agricultural Land Commission (ALC) regulations and City of Chilliwack Zoning Bylaw rules, principal residences on ALR land are subject to maximum total floor-area caps unless approved by the ALC, and an additional small secondary residence is permitted subject to floor-area and municipal servicing/hydrogeological rules.
Do rural estates in Ryder Lake and Majuba Hill have municipal water and sewer?

Most rural acreages in Ryder Lake, Majuba Hill, Yarrow, Greendale, East Chilliwack, and Columbia Valley use private septic systems and either private drilled wells or rural water systems. Always include well flow-rate, potability, and certified septic inspection clauses in your offer.
What is Development Permit Area 2 (DPA2) on Chilliwack hillside estates?

DPA2 covers Chilliwack's designated hillside and upland areas (including Chilliwack Mountain, Little Mountain, Promontory, Ryder Lake, Eastern Hillsides, Vedder Mountain, and Majuba Hill) and requires geotechnical slope-stability, drainage, and wildfire-interface permits before land clearing, subdivision, or building.
Can you buy freehold waterfront or beach homes at Cultus Lake?

Cultus Lake includes both Cultus Lake Park Board leasehold homes (inside Cultus Lake Park) and freehold (fee-simple) homes in Lindell Beach (Cultus Lake South) and Cultus Lake East / Aquadel. Always verify whether a listing is leasehold or freehold.
Are some listings over $1.8M in Chilliwack urban infill or multi-lot assemblies?

Yes. In addition to custom view homes and rural estates, listings over $1.8M occasionally include larger subdividable urban parcels in Sardis, Chilliwack Proper, or Downtown Chilliwack designated for townhouse or multi-family infill under the Chilliwack 2050 OCP.
